full_sentence: Before you bake the cake, preheat the oven to 180 degrees.

options.why_wrong: 'Before' introduces an action that must happen earlier than the main event. Eating the cake happens after baking, so this option reverses the order.

explanation: After 'before', we need an action that happens earlier than the main clause. Preheating the oven must come before baking, so it fits the time order. Portuguese speakers often mix up time order with cause when they use similar connectors, so check whether the word shows sequence.
